source._note: Layout-map trace, translated 2026-07-27 to OSM street anchors (Buckley Rd lon -104.7909, E 88th Ave lat 39.85640). Position is FITTED to those anchors, not surveyed and not traced from the aerial scar - see source/SOURCING.md. The pre-placement KML is kept with a non-.kml suffix on purpose: centerline_from_kml() globs source/*.km* and would otherwise pick it. route._orientation_doc: Research 2026-07-20: Second Creek ran CLOCKWISE as the primary direction (SCCA-CDR kept separate CW/CCW record books; CW records to 1985, CW is faster). Our ring was CCW -> reverse. S/F on the Buckley Straight (the old Denver Dragway strip, west edge, cars heading NORTH into the Oval Turn), ~39.8595,-104.7896. Pit Road ~280 m on the WEST side of the straight (driver's left), entry mid-straight, exit at the Oval Turn. A CCW layout (2001-2005 era) is a future variant.

road_profile._doc: Site redeveloped after closure, so 3DEP measures graded pads and spoil heaps, not the 1970s racing surface (raw p95 step 0.35 m, max 1.04 m over 3 m). 120 m median rejects heaps the 33 m default cannot; 4% cap suits a flat plains circuit with 16 m of relief over 2.7 km.
